verdict.rationale: Exporting account data in open formats is a fair question for a SaaS automation platform, so the axis applies. Nothing in the evidence pack documents exporting Zaps, workflow definitions, task history or account data. The items cover building integrations, the MCP server, the SDK and embedding, and community remarks about wanting to switch vendors describe user intent, not a product capability.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can export all of my data in open formats and leave
